blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual world models increasingly support spatial reasoning by generating RGB views of unobserved states. However, RGB has become the default interface largely because it is well suited for visual generation, rather than necessarily being the most effective representation for downstream reasoning. Different spatial questions may benefit from different representations of the same imagined state: top-down geometry can facilitate global distance comparisons, while panoramic views provide broader context for reasoning about open space. To isolate the role of representation in spatial imagination, we introduce ImagiRep, a simulator-grounded benchmark of 922 questions spanning seven question types across two settings, Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Integration, providing oracle RGB and six alternative representations (e.g., depth, panoramic views, and top-down geometry) of the same unobserved state. This controlled comparison reveals that even accurate imagined RGB does not guarantee accurate spatial reasoning, and different questions benefit from different representations. Similar trends hold for representations derived from world-model-estimated states. Notably, estimated RGB alone can mislead spatial reasoning, while alternative representations retain complementary benefits. Building on these findings, we introduce GEARS, a lightweight test-time strategy for adaptive representation selection, outperforming existing spatial imagination methods and showing that reasoning about unseen states requires more than generating RGB views.
blocks.zh: 视觉世界模型通过产生未被观测国家的RGB观点,日益支持空间推理. 然而,RGB成为了默认接口,主要是因为它非常适合视觉生成,而不一定是下游推理最有效的代表. 不同的空间问题可能得益于同一想象状态的不同表现:自上而下几何可以促进全球相距比较,而全景观则为开阔空间的推理提供了更广泛的背景. 为了孤立在空间想象中代表的作用,我们引入了ImagiRep,一个由922个问题组成的模拟基准,涵盖7个问题类型,涉及两个设置,即 Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Institution,提供oracle RGB和6个没有观测状态的替代代表(如深度,全景,自上而下几何等). 这种有控制的比较揭示出,即使准确的想象中的RGB也不能保证准确的空间推理,不同的问题也从不同的表述中受益. 由世界模型估计的国家得出的表述也呈现出类似趋势。 值得注意的是,仅靠估计的RGB就可能误导空间推理,而替代表述保留了互补的好处。 基于这些发现,我们引入了GEARS, 一种轻量级测试时间策略,用于适应性表现选择, 优于现有空间想象方法, 并显示对不可见状态的推理 需要的不仅仅是产生RGB的观点。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent spatial reasoning systems increasingly use visual world models to imagine what lies beyond the current observation. Many spatial questions involve changes in viewpoint, such as what becomes visible after a turn or how object relations change after moving. Given a movement or hypothetical action, these systems generate future RGB views and feed them back to a vision-language model for reasoning Yang et al. (2025b) ; Yu et al. (2026) ; Zhu et al. (2026) ; Yuan et al. (2026) . These generated views provide explicit evidence about an unobserved state, complementing what the model can infer from its initial observations.
blocks.zh: 最近的空间推理系统越来越多地使用视觉世界模型来想象超越当前观测的事物. 许多空间问题涉及视角的变化,如转弯后可看到什么,或者物体关系在移动后如何变化. 鉴于一种运动或假设行动,这些系统产生未来的RGB观点,并将其反馈到一种视觉语言模型中,用于推理杨等人(2025b);于等人(2026);朱等人(2026);袁等人(2026). 这些所产生的观点为未观察状态提供了明确的证据,补充了模型从其初步观察中可以推断的情况。

blocks.en:
Figure 1: Spatial imagination is more than generating future RGB views. The same imagined state may support different spatial questions (e.g., top-down
geometry helps global distance comparisons; panoramic views facilitate reasoning about open space), yet existing approaches typically expose it to the reasoner only through RGB. ImagiRep provides controlled access to the same underlying state through multiple representations, allowing us to study how the choice of representation affects downstream spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh:
图1:空间想象力不仅仅是产生未来的RGB观点. 相同的想象状态可能支持不同的空间问题(例如:自上而下)
几何学有助于全局距离比较;全景观点有利于对开放空间的推理),然而现有的方法通常只能通过RGB将其暴露在理性中. ImagiRep通过多种表达方式提供对同一基本状态的控制访问,使我们能够研究代表的选择如何影响下游空间推理.

blocks.en:
RGB is a natural representation for generation because it preserves rich visual appearance and is the standard output of modern visual world models Agarwal et al. (2025) ; Du et al. (2023) ; Bar et al. (2025) ; Zhou et al. (2025) . Consequently, existing spatial imagination methods largely treat RGB as the default interface between world models and downstream reasoners Yu et al. (2026) ; Yang et al. (2025b) . However, this choice is driven by how imagined states are generated, rather than by which representation best supports spatial reasoning across different question types.
As illustrated in Fig. 1 , the same imagined spatial state can support diverse questions about visibility, distance, and free space, where representations such as depth and panorama can make distance cues and surrounding spatial context more explicit than RGB alone.
This raises a fundamental question: should all spatial reasoning tasks rely on imagined RGB views, or could alternative representations better support different reasoning needs?
blocks.zh:
RGB是一代人的自然代表,因为它保留了丰富的视觉外观,是现代视觉世界模型Agarwal等人(2025年);Du等人(2023年);Bar等人(2025年);周等人(2025年)的标准输出. 因此,现有的空间想象方法在很大程度上将RGB作为世界模型和下游理性器之间的默认接口. Yu等人(2026); Yang等人(2025b). 然而,这种选择的驱动力是想象中的状态是如何产生的,而不是由哪一种代表最能支持不同问题类型的空间推理。
如图1所示,相同的想象空间状态可以支持关于能见度,距离和自由空间的不同问题,其中深度和全景等表达方式可以使距离提示和周围空间背景比仅RGB更清晰.
这提出了一个根本性的问题:所有空间推理任务是否都依赖于想象中的RGB观点,还是其他的表达方式能更好地支持不同的推理需求?

blocks.en:
To understand how different representations affect spatial reasoning, we need to compare them under the same underlying spatial state.
Therefore, we first introduce ImagiRep , a simulator-grounded benchmark for systematically studying how different representations of imagined spatial states affect reasoning. ImagiRep includes two complementary settings: Viewpoint Imagination (Fig. 2 (a)), which requires reasoning about spatial relations after an instructed movement, and Cross-view Integration (Fig. 2 (b)), which requires combining information across partial observations.
Using ground-truth scene geometry and camera poses, we obtain oracle RGB and six alternative representations ( Depth , Surface Normals , Panorama , Top-down Geometry , Spatial Text , and RGB Video ).
To examine how representation utility varies across reasoning needs, we design seven question categories across two settings, covering directional reasoning, nearest/farthest-object comparisons, visibility, and spatial ordering. For example, open-space reasoning may benefit from panoramic views, while global distance comparisons may benefit from top-down geometry. By keeping the underlying spatial state and question fixed, ImagiRep enables controlled comparisons of how different representations support spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh:
为了了解不同的表达方式如何影响空间推理,我们需要在相同的基础空间状态下对其进行比较.
因此,我们首先提出ImagiRep,这是系统研究想象空间状态的不同表现如何影响推理的模拟基准。 ImagiRep包含两个互补的设置: Viewpoint Imagination(图2(a)),它要求在指示运动后对空间关系进行推理,以及交叉视图整合(图2(b)),它需要将信息综合到部分观测中.
利用地面真实的场景几何和相机的姿势,我们获得了oracle RGB和六个替代的表示(深度、表面正常、全景、上下几何、空间文本和RGB视频)。
为了审查各种推理需求如何不同,我们设计了七类问题,涵盖两种环境,包括方向推理、最近/最远对象比较、可见度和空间秩序。 例如,开放空间推理可能从全景视图中受益,而全球距离比较则可能从自上而下几何角度受益. 通过保持基础空间状态和问题固定,ImagiRep能够对不同表示如何支持空间推理进行有控制的比较.

blocks.en:
Our findings reveal a gap between the accuracy of imagined views and their usefulness for spatial reasoning, a pattern observed across both GPT-6.1-sol and Gemini 3.7 Flash. For example, with GPT-6.1-sol, adding oracle endpoint RGB reduces accuracy on Farthest Object questions from 68.4% to 58.2%. Yet top-down geometry raises the corresponding score to 75.5%, showing that how spatial information is presented matters.
More broadly, different representations provide complementary benefits across models and questions, with no single representation consistently performing best.
Beyond oracle representations, we further investigate a realistic setting where world models estimate unobserved spatial states and provide corresponding representations for reasoning. Interestingly, representations derived from these estimated states can still improve spatial reasoning, even when estimated RGB views alone degrade performance.
Together, these findings suggest that effective spatial imagination depends not only on the accuracy of imagined views, but also on how spatial information is represented and understood by the reasoner.
blocks.zh:
我们的研究结果揭示了想象观点的准确性与其对空间推理的实用性之间的差距,这一模式在GPT-6.1-sol和双子座3.7 Flash上都观察到。 例如,使用GPT-6.1-sol,添加oracle端点RGB,将最远对象问题的精度从68.4%降低到58.2%. 然而,自上而下几何将相应的分数提高到75.5%,表明空间信息是如何呈现的。
更广泛地说,不同的表述方式提供了各种模式和问题的互补效益,没有一个单一的表述方式一贯表现最佳。
除了甲骨文表述之外,我们进一步调查一种现实的环境,即世界模型对未观测到的空间状态作出估计,并为推理提供相应的表述。 有趣的是,从这些估计状态中衍生出来的表达仍然可以改善空间推理,即使仅仅估计的RGB观点会降低性能.
这些研究结果合在一起表明,有效的空间想象不仅取决于想象中观点的准确性,而且还取决于空间信息是如何被理性者表示和理解的.

blocks.en:
Motivated by these findings, we next introduce GEARS ( G ated E vidence and A daptive R epresentation S election) (shown in Fig. 5 ), a lightweight test-time strategy that adaptively determines when to use imagined evidence and which representation to select.
Rather than assuming that imagined RGB is always beneficial, GEARS first examines the agreement between predictions based on observed evidence and those incorporating estimated RGB.
When the predictions disagree, it adaptively selects among observed evidence and estimated representations to support spatial reasoning. GEARS achieves 61.4% accuracy on Viewpoint Imagination and 77.7% on Cross-view Integration, outperforming other spatial imagination methods.
Nevertheless, a substantial gap remains compared with oracle-assisted results, highlighting the need for world models to not only estimate unobserved states more accurately, but also provide spatial information that reasoners can effectively use.
blocks.zh:
受这些调查结果的驱使,我们接下来推出GEARS(G ated E evidence and A dapition R election S election)(在图5中显示),这是一种轻量级测试-时间策略,适应性地决定了何时使用想象的证据以及选择何种代表.
GEARS不是假设想象中的RGB总是有好处的,而是首先审查基于观察到的证据的预测与包含估计的RGB的预测之间的一致.
当预测有分歧时,它会因地制宜地在观测到的证据和估计表述中选择支持空间推理. GEARS在 Viewpoint Imagination 上实现了61.4%的精度,在交叉视图集成上实现了77.7%的精度,比其他空间想象方法表现优异.
然而,与甲骨文协助的结果相比,仍然存在巨大差距,突出表明世界模型不仅需要更准确地估计未观测到的国家,而且还需要提供解释者能够有效利用的空间信息。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Visual Spatial Reasoning. Spatial reasoning in vision-language models has been studied across a broad range of abilities, from relative position, depth, and orientation in single images ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) to perspective taking and reasoning under ego and object motion ( Ray et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ) , cross-view correspondence ( Yeh et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ) , mental modeling from limited views ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , and spatial memory and situated awareness in video ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026a ) .
While these benchmarks evaluate diverse spatial reasoning abilities, they do not systematically examine how different representations of the same unobserved state affect reasoning. In contrast, our ImagiRep provides multiple oracle representations of the same simulator-grounded target state, enabling controlled comparisons while keeping the spatial state and question fixed.
blocks.zh:
视觉空间理性. 对视觉语言模型中的空间推理进行了广泛的能力研究,从相对位置、深度和单一图像的定向(Chen等人,2024年;Fu等人,2024年;Ma等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2026年)到自觉和物体运动下的视角取向和推理(Ray等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年b年b年),交叉视图对应(Yeh等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026年b年b年),有限观点的思维模型(Wang等人,2026年b年b年),以及视频中的空间记忆和定位意识(Yang等人,2025年a年; Yang等人,2026a;Li等人,2026a).
虽然这些基准评估了不同的空间推理能力,但它们并没有系统地审查同一未观察状态的不同表述如何影响推理。 相比之下,我们的ImagiRep提供了同一模拟基于目标状态的多个甲骨文表示,使得可以进行有控制的比较,同时保持空间状态和问题固定.

blocks.en:
Spatial Imagination with World Models. Action- and camera-conditioned video models can now render plausible unseen views ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Bar et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Parker-Holder and Fruchter, 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026d ) , and several works feed these views back to an agent or reasoner ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Hwang et al., 2026 ) .
AVIC ( Yu et al., 2026 ) and Astra ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) further explore selective world-model use through controlled views or camera motions.
However, these methods primarily rely on imagined RGB views, despite emerging world models that can also generate depth, surface normals, and camera geometry ( Aether Team et al., 2025 ) .
Yet the ability to generate these representations does not establish whether they are more useful for downstream spatial reasoning.
Our work addresses this by systematically comparing representations of the same unobserved state under oracle and estimated imagination, and exploring adaptive representation selection at test time.
blocks.zh:
与世界模型的空间想象. 动作和摄像设备的视频模型现在可以使不见得的观点变得可信(Agarwal等人,2025年;Bar等人,2025年;Zhou等人,2025年;Parker-Holder和Fruchter,2025年;Wang等人,2026年c;Wang等人,2026年d),以及一些作品将这些观点反馈给代理人或理性人(Lu等人,2024年;Huang等人,2026年;Yang等人,2025年b;Yuan等人,2026年;Hwang等人,2026年)。
AVIC(Yu et al., 2026)和Astra(Zhu et al., 2026)进一步探索通过可控视图或相机运动进行选择性的世界模型使用.
然而,这些方法主要依靠想象中的RGB观点,尽管新出现的世界模型也能产生深度,表面常态,以及相机几何(Aether Team等人,2025年).
然而,产生这些表述的能力并不能确定这些表述是否更有助于下游空间推理。
我们的工作通过系统地比较在甲骨文和估计想象力下同一未观察状态的表述,并探讨在试验时的适应性表述选择来解决这个问题。

blocks.zh: 3 ImagiRep:空间想象控制基准

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of ImagiRep . The top left illustrates benchmark construction, including a 3D scene, movement instructions, and observed view. The top right shows oracle RGB and six alternative representations of the same imagined state. The lower panels present example questions and ground-truth answers for the Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Integration question types.
blocks.zh: 图2:ImagiRep概览. 左上方显示基准构造,包括三维场景、移动指示和观察视图。 右上方显示甲骨文RGB和六个相同的想象状态的替代表示. 低层面板为 Viewpoint 想象和交叉视图整合问题类型提出问题和地面真实答案。

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmark Overview and Design Principles
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准概述和设计原则

blocks.en:
Spatial cognition involves reasoning about environments beyond the immediately observed view, including updating spatial relations after movement, integrating information across viewpoints, and reasoning within different spatial reference frames Rieser (1989) .
Prior research on spatial cognition has studied these processes and the role of spatial representations in supporting them Tversky (2003) ; Burgess (2006) ; Wang et al. (2026b) ; Ray et al. (2025) .
Inspired by these distinctions, we design ImagiRep to evaluate spatial reasoning over unobserved states through diverse questions and controlled representation inputs.
blocks.zh:
空间认知涉及超越立即观测到的视角的环境推理,包括移动后更新空间关系,整合跨观点信息,以及在不同空间参考框架里进行推理 Rieser (1989年).
以前关于空间认知的研究研究过这些过程以及空间表达在支持它们方面的作用(特维尔斯基(2003年);伯吉斯(2006年);王等人(2026年b);雷等人(2025年).
受这些区分的启发,我们设计了ImagiRep,通过各种问题和有控制的代表性投入来评价空间推理相对于未观测国家.

blocks.en:
Recent benchmarks Ray et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2026b) ; Wang et al. (2026b) evaluate these spatial reasoning capabilities through questions involving perspective changes, object relations, and imagined movements. However, these benchmarks are not designed to provide controlled access to the underlying spatial states across different representations. This makes it difficult to isolate the effect of representation choice from errors in estimating or generating the imagined state.
To address this limitation, we construct ImagiRep using Matterport3D Chang et al. (2017) , which provides 3D scene geometry and camera poses.
This allows us to obtain different representations of the same ground-truth spatial state while keeping the underlying scene and question fixed. ImagiRep follows three design principles: (1) Reasoning over unobserved spatial states , with questions involving viewpoint changes and spatial integration across partial observations; (2) Diverse spatial reasoning tasks , covering directions, distances, visibility, and object ordering to probe different spatial information needs; and (3) Controlled representation comparisons , where the same underlying spatial state and question are held fixed while the representation of imagined evidence is varied.
blocks.zh:
最近的基准Ray等人(2025);Yang等人(2026b); Wang et al. (2026b)通过涉及视角变化,物体关系,以及想象中的运动等问题来评价这些空间推理能力. 然而,这些基准并非旨在在不同表述中提供对基础空间状态的控制准入。 这使得很难将代表选择的影响与估计或产生想象状态的错误分开。
为了克服这一限制,我们用 Matterport3D 构建 ImagiRep Chang et al. (2017),提供3D场景几何和相机姿势.
这使得我们能够获得同一地面真实空间状态的不同表述,同时保持基本场景和提问的固定。 ImagiRep遵循三个设计原则: (1) 未观测空间状态的原因,涉及观点变化和部分观测的空间融合问题;(2) 涉及方向、距离、能见度和物体的多元空间推理任务,以探寻不同的空间信息需求;(3) 受控的表示比较,即相同的基本空间状态和问题固定不变,而假想证据的表示方式则各不相同。

blocks.en: To achieve this, as shown in Fig. 2 , we sample movement routes and groups of views from Matterport3D scenes for Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Integration, respectively. Human annotators write spatial questions based on the resulting observations and movement instructions. Using the corresponding scene geometry and camera poses, we obtain oracle RGB and six alternative representations of imagined evidence. The question, observed inputs, and answer options remain fixed across representation conditions, allowing us to isolate the effect of representation choice.
blocks.zh: 为了实现这一点,如图2所示,我们分别从 Matterport3D 场景中取样移动路线和一组观点,用于 Viewpoint Imagination 和 交叉视图集成. 人类的注释者根据由此产生的观测和运动指示来写空间问题. 利用相应的场景几何和相机的姿势,我们获得了oracle RGB和六种假想证据的替代表示. 这一问题、观察到的投入和答案选择在代表条件上仍然固定不变,使我们能够孤立代表选择的影响。

blocks.en: 3.2 Spatial Imagination Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.2 空间想象任务

blocks.en: Reasoning about unobserved spatial states presents two complementary challenges: updating spatial relations after a change in viewpoint and integrating spatial information distributed across partial observations. We design two settings to study representation utility under these different conditions.
blocks.zh: 关于未观测到的空间状态的理由提出了两个相辅相成的挑战:在观点变化后更新空间关系和整合分布在部分观测中的空间信息。 我们设计了两种环境来研究这些不同条件下的代表效用.

blocks.en:
(1) Viewpoint imagination requires reasoning about a new viewpoint after an instructed movement, where spatial relations must be updated relative to the observer’s new position and orientation. Given an initial RGB observation, the model receives a movement instruction specifying a route and final heading, and answers questions about the resulting viewpoint. We sample straight and turning routes from the navigable connectivity graph, spanning one to three edges and approximately 0.5–9 meters. We favor routes connecting different rooms and endpoints surrounded by recognizable objects to support diverse spatial questions.
We design six question types that probe different spatial relations: Open-space Direction , Nearest-obstacle Direction , and Object-relative Direction for directional reasoning; Nearest Object and Farthest Object for distance comparison; and Visibility for determining whether the starting area remains visible after movement.
blocks.zh:
(1) Viewpoint 想象力要求在指示运动后对新观点进行推理,相对于观察者的新位置和方向,空间关系必须更新. 鉴于最初的RGB观察,该模型会收到一个运动指令,指定一个路径和最终方向,并回答关于由此产生的观点的问题. 我们从可导航连接图中取样直线和转弯路线,跨越一至三边,大约0.5至9米。 我们倾向于连接不同房间和端点的路线,这些端点被可识别的物体包围,以支持不同的空间问题。
我们设计了6个问题类型 探索不同的空间关系: 用于方向推理的开放空间方向,近视方向,以及对象相对方向; 用于距离比较的近视对象和远视对象; 用于确定起始区域在移动后是否仍然可见的可见度.

blocks.en: Table 1: Complementary benefits of oracle representations . Oracle selection counts a question as correct if the endpoint RGB alone or any one of the additional representations answers it correctly. Videos are provided as 16 uniformly sampled frames. Best and second-best results are marked in bold and underlined, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表1:甲骨文表述的补充效益 Oracle选择将一个问题计算为正确,如果一个结束点RGB或任何附加的表示正确回答它. 录像作为16个统一抽样的框架提供。 最佳和次最佳成果分别以粗体和下划线标出。

blocks.en:
(2) Cross-view integration examines how spatial information distributed across partial observations can be combined to reason about an unobserved viewpoint. When relevant objects appear in different views, their spatial relations are not directly observable in any single image, requiring the model to integrate information across viewpoints.
To study this, we construct groups of two or three partially overlapping RGB observations captured from different views.
We consider Cross-view Nearest Object and Cross-view Farthest Object , which follow the same reasoning tasks as in Viewpoint Imagination but require comparing objects across different views. We additionally introduce Spatial Ordering , which asks the model to determine the ordering of objects relative to a specified viewpoint.
blocks.zh:
(2) 交叉观点综合研究如何将部分观测中分布的空间信息与未观察观点相结合。 当相关物体在不同观点中出现时,其空间关系在任何单一图像中都没有直接观测到,要求模型将跨视角的信息整合.
为了研究这一点,我们构建了两组或三组部分重叠的RGB观测数据,从不同的观点中获取。
我们考虑交叉视图最近对象和交叉视图最远对象,它们遵循的推理任务与Viewpoint Imagination中相同,但需要在不同观点中比较对象. 我们还引入了空间秩序(Space Ordering ),它要求模型确定物体相对于特定视角的顺序.

blocks.en: 3.3 Representations of Imagined States
blocks.zh: 3.3 想象中国家的代表

blocks.en: For each question, we identify the target viewpoint in Matterport3D and render the corresponding oracle RGB image using its ground-truth camera pose. Leveraging the simulator’s 3D geometry and camera information, we further obtain six additional representations: Depth , Surface Normals , Panorama , Top-down Geometry , Spatial Text , and Video (Fig. 2 ). Depth and surface normals are rendered from the target viewpoint, while panoramas and top-down maps provide broader spatial context. Spatial text describes camera movements derived from ground-truth poses, and videos capture movement along the route or transitions between observed views. All representations are derived from the same underlying 3D scene, enabling controlled comparisons of their utility for spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 对于每个问题,我们在Matterport3D中确定目标视角,并使用其地面真实相机的姿势来渲染相应的oracle RGB图像. 利用模拟器的3D几何和相机信息,我们进一步获得了另外6种表达方式:深度、表面正常、全景、自上而下几何、空间文本和视频(图2)。 深度和表面的常态从目标角度进行渲染,而全景和自上而下的地图则提供了更广泛的空间背景. 空间文本描述了从地面真实姿势中衍生出来的摄像头运动,视频捕获沿路运动或观测到的视角之间的过渡. 所有表述都来源于同一基础的立体场景,从而可以对其用于空间推理的效用进行有控制的比较.

blocks.en: 3.4 Dataset Statistics and Quality Control
blocks.zh: 3.4 数据集统计与质量控制

blocks.en: ImagiRep contains 922 human-annotated spatial questions, including 622 Viewpoint Imagination questions from 200 routes across 73 scenes and 300 Cross-view Integration questions from 143 view groups across 21 scenes (Table 6 in Appendix A.1 ). Human annotators write the questions and identify the correct answers from four candidate options based on the corresponding scenes and viewpoints. All examples undergo manual review to ensure that the spatial relations are inferable from the provided observations and movement instructions. We additionally check rendering quality, camera-pose alignment, and annotation consistency, remove duplicate routes, and randomize answer options to reduce potential biases manually.
blocks.zh: ImagiRep包含922个人类附加说明的空间问题,包括来自横跨73场景的200条路线的622个Videopoint想象问题和来自横跨21场景的143个视图组的300个交叉视图整合问题(附录A.1中的表6). 人类的注释者根据相应的场景和观点来写问题,并找出四个候选选项的正确答案. 所有例子都经过人工审查,以确保空间关系能够从所提供的观测和移动指示中推断出来。 我们还检查渲染质量、相机对齐和注释一致性,去掉重复的路径,随机排列答案选项,以手工减少潜在的偏差。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluating Imagined Evidence for Spatial Reasoning
blocks.zh: 4 评价空间理由的想象证据

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate how imagined evidence affects spatial reasoning. We first test whether oracle endpoint RGB improves performance (Sec. 4.2 ), then examine whether alternative oracle representations provide further gains (Sec. 4.3 ), and finally assess whether these benefits persist with estimated imagination (Sec. 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们评价想象中的证据如何影响空间推理。 我们首先测试oracle端点RGB是否提高性能(第4.2条),然后审查替代的oracle表达是否带来进一步的收益(第4.3条),最后评估这些收益是否持续有估计的想象力(第4.4条)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Models and evaluation metric. We evaluate two multimodal reasoning models, GPT-6.1-sol ( OpenAI, 2026 ) and Gemini 3.7 Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , using high reasoning effort. Since GPT-6.1-sol achieves higher oracle-selection accuracy across both settings, we use it as the primary reasoner for estimated imagination and test-time experiments.
Both models receive identical questions, answer options, and representation-specific inputs in the oracle comparisons, and are instructed to select one of four answer choices (A–D). We report accuracy (%) as the percentage of correctly answered questions.
blocks.zh:
模式和评价尺度。 我们评价两个多模式推理模型,GPT-6.1-sol(OpenAI,2026年)和双子座3.7 Flash(Google DeepMind,2026年),使用高推理能力. 由于GPT-6.1-sol在两种设置中都实现了更高的甲骨文选择精度,我们用它作为估计想象力和测试时间实验的首要理由.
两个模型在甲骨文比较中都收到相同的问题,解答选项,以及代表特异性输入,并被指示在四个解答选项中选择一个(A–D). 我们报告准确性(%)为正确回答问题的百分比。

blocks.en: Input conditions. We first establish three conditions: question-only, observed view(s), and observed view(s) augmented with oracle endpoint RGB. We then examine six alternative representations of the same target state: top-down geometry, spatial text, video, depth, surface normals, and panorama. Each representation is provided alongside the observed view(s) and endpoint RGB, while the question, answer options, and underlying spatial state remain fixed. We additionally evaluate estimated representations to study the effect of imperfect imagination.
blocks.zh: 输入条件. 我们首先确定了三个条件:只问,观察的视图,观察的视图加上甲骨文端点RGB. 然后,我们审查同一种目标状态的六个备选表述:自上而下几何、空间文本、视频、深度、表面常态和全景。 每种表示都与观测到的观点和终点RGB一起提供,而问题、答案选项和基础空间状态则保持不变。 我们还评估了估计的表述,以研究不完善想象的影响。

blocks.en: Estimated representations. We use HY-World 2.0 ( Team HY-World, 2026 ) for Viewpoint Imagination, generating a 3D scene from the initial observation and following a trajectory planned from the movement instruction. Endpoint RGB and the alternative visual representations are rendered from this generated scene, while spatial text describes the planned camera movements. For Cross-view Integration, we use Stable Virtual Camera (SEVA) ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) to synthesize endpoint RGB from the observed views and consider depth estimated from the synthesized RGB as the additional representation. Implementation details are provided in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: 估计陈述。 我们使用HY-World 2.0(Team HY-World,2026年)进行Videopoint想象,从最初的观测中产生一个3D场景,并遵循运动指令中规划的轨迹. endpoint RGB和替代的视觉表现来自这个生成的场景,而空间文本则描述了计划中的相机运动. 对于跨视融合,我们使用稳定虚拟相机(SEVA)(周等,2025年)从观测到的视角合成端点RGB,并考虑从合成的RGB中估计的深度作为额外的表示. 执行情况详情见附录A.3。

blocks.en: 4.2 Does Oracle Imagination Improve Spatial Reasoning?
blocks.zh: 4.2 甲骨文想象是否改进了空间理性?

blocks.en:
We first examine whether providing oracle imagined views improves spatial reasoning over unobserved states. As shown in Table 2 , Question-only performance is close to the random baseline, suggesting that language priors alone provide limited information for answering these spatial questions.
Providing observed views substantially improves 20+% absolute accuracy for both models and settings, suggesting that VLMs can already infer some spatial relations without explicit imagined evidence. Interestingly, both models achieve lower accuracy on Viewpoint Imagination than on Cross-view Integration, suggesting that reasoning about spatial changes after movement is more challenging than integrating information across observed views.
Adding an oracle endpoint RGB further improves accuracy by around 10% across both models and settings. Nevertheless, substantial errors remain even with ground-truth endpoint views, suggesting that accurate imagined RGB alone is insufficient for reliable spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh:
我们首先审查提供甲骨文想象的观点是否改善了空间推理,而不是未观测到的国家。 如表2所示,唯问性能接近随机基线,说明语言前缀本身为解答这些空间问题提供了有限的信息.
提供观测到的意见大大改进了模型和设置的20QQ绝对准确性,表明VLM已经可以推断出一些空间关系,而没有明确的想象证据. 有趣的是,这两个模型在 Viewpoint Imaginination 上的精度都比在交叉视图集成上的精度要低,这表明在移动后对空间变化的推理比在观测到的各种观点中整合信息更具挑战性.
添加甲骨文端点RGB,在模型和设置上进一步提高精度约10%. 然而,即使对地面真相终点的看法也存在重大错误,这表明仅凭准确的想象中的RGB不足以进行可靠的空间推理。

blocks.en:
The benefits of oracle RGB vary considerably across question types.
As shown in Tables 1 and 7 , both models achieve substantial improvements on visibility and object-relative direction questions, while performance on farthest-object reasoning remains unchanged or even decreases. For example, GPT-6.1-sol drops from 68.4% to 58.2% on Farthest Object despite receiving the ground-truth endpoint view.
This observation is consistent with AVIC Yu et al. (2026) , which highlights the importance of selectively invoking imagination rather than assuming that additional imagined views are always beneficial.
blocks.zh:
oracle RGB的优点因问题类型而大不相同.
如表1和表7所示,两种模型在可见度和对象相对方向问题上都取得了实质性的改善,而最远对象推理上的性能则保持不变甚至下降. 例如,GPT-6.1-溶液在最远对象上从68.4%下降到58.2%,尽管收到了地面-真实终点视图。
这一观点与AVIC Yu等人(2026年)的观点是一致的,后者强调了有选择地引用想象力的重要性,而不是假设额外的想象观点总是有益的.

blocks.en: Finding 1: Oracle imagined RGB improves spatial reasoning overall, but can degrade performance on certain question types, such as Farthest Object, showing that accurate visual evidence does not guarantee better reasoning.
blocks.zh: 查找 1:甲骨文想象的RGB整体上改进了空间推理,但可以在诸如Farthest Object等某些问题类型上降解性能,表明准确的视觉证据并不能保证更好的推理.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Example comparison of oracle and estimated spatial representations for Viewpoint Imagination . Oracle representations are from ground-truth 3D scenes; estimated representations are obtained from HY-World 2.0.
blocks.zh: 图3:Viewpoint想象的甲骨文和估计空间表示的示例比较。 Oracle表示来自地面真实的3D场景;估计表示来自HY-World 2.0.

blocks.en: 4.3 Can Alternative Representations Improve Reasoning Beyond RGB?
blocks.zh: 4.3 替代代表能否改进超越《规则》的理由?

blocks.en:
We next investigate whether alternative representations can provide useful spatial information beyond oracle endpoint RGB. As shown in Table 1 , all six representations recover some errors made with oracle RGB across both reasoning settings. For GPT-6.1-sol, panorama achieves the highest overall recovery score on Viewpoint Imagination (79.3% vs. 66.1% with RGB), while depth performs best on Cross-view Integration (84.7% vs. 75.7%). Similar improvements are observed with Gemini 3.7 Flash, as shown in Table 7 in Appendix A.2 where top-down geometry performs best on Viewpoint Imagination (73.0% vs. 63.7% with RGB) and video on Cross-view Integration (85.3% vs. 78.7%).
These results suggest that even when the imagined RGB is accurate, alternative representations can provide complementary evidence that the reasoner does not fully extract from RGB alone.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们调查替代表述是否能够提供超出oracle端点RGB的有用空间信息. 如表1所示,所有6种表述都收回了在两种推理设置中使用oracle RGB得出的一些错误. 对于GPT-6.1-sol,全景在Videopoint Imagination上实现了最高的整体恢复分数(79.3%对66.1%的RGB),而深度在交叉视图整合上表现最好(84.7%对75.7%). 双子座3.7 Flash也有类似的改进,附录A.2表7显示,自上而下几何在Viewpoint Imagination(73.0%对63.7%与RGB)和View-view Integration(85.3%对78.7%)上表现最好。
这些结果表明,即使想象中的RGB是准确的,另类表述也可以提供补充证据,证明理性人并不完全从RGB中提取.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Example comparison of oracle and estimated representations for Cross-view Integration . Estimated RGB is synthesized by SEVA, and estimated depth is predicted from the synthesized RGB.
blocks.zh: 图 4:交叉观点一体化的甲骨文和估计表述的示例比较 . 估计RGB由SEVA合成,估计深度由合成RGB预测.

blocks.en: Importantly, the benefits of different representations depend on the spatial information required by the question. Top-down geometry performs best on Farthest Object questions (75.5% vs. 58.2% with RGB), suggesting that explicit scene layout helps reason about objects distributed across a larger area. Panorama improves Open-space Direction from 57.1% to 73.6%, where a wider field of view provides more information about the surrounding space. In contrast, depth performs best on Cross-view Nearest Object questions (84.0% vs. 74.1% with RGB), where explicit distance cues may facilitate comparisons across viewpoints. These patterns suggest different representations make different spatial relationships easier to reason about by making relevant spatial cues more explicit.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,不同表述的好处取决于问题所需的空间信息。 自上而下几何在远端对象问题上表现最好(75.5%对58.2%的RGB),说明清晰的场景布局有助于解释分布在更大区域的物体. 全景将开放空间方向从57.1%提高到73.6%,其中更广的视野提供了更多关于周围空间的信息. 与此相对照,深度在交叉视图最近对象问题(84.0%对74.1%与RGB)上表现最好,其中明确的距离提示可以促进跨视角比较。 这些模式表明,通过使相关空间提示更加明确,不同的空间关系更容易解释。

blocks.en: This complementarity also explains why no single representation consistently performs best. Oracle selection across representations achieves 87.5% on Viewpoint Imagination and 91.7% on Cross-view Integration, exceeding the best fixed representations (79.3% and 84.7%, respectively). Although this represents an upper bound based on ground-truth correctness, it highlights the potential of selecting representations according to the spatial evidence needed for each question.
blocks.zh: 这种互补性也解释了为什么没有一个单一代表一贯发挥最佳作用。 不同表述的甲骨文选择在Viewpoint想象中达到87.5%,在交叉视角整合中达到91.7%,超过了最佳固定表述(分别为79.3%和84.7%). 虽然这代表着基于地面真实性的上限,但它突出了根据每个问题所需的空间证据选择表述的可能性。

blocks.en: Finding 2: Alternative representations provide complementary spatial evidence beyond RGB, with their benefits varying across question types. No single representation consistently performs best.
blocks.zh: 查找 2:替代表述提供了超出RGB的补充空间证据,其好处因问题类型而异. 没有一个单一代表一贯表现最好。

blocks.en: 4.4 Do Representation Benefits Persist under Imperfect Imagination?
blocks.zh: 4.4 在不完善的想象中,代表性是否具有持久性?

blocks.en:
So far, our analysis has focused on oracle representations derived from ground-truth 3D scenes. We now investigate whether their complementary benefits persist when the imagined state must be estimated from observed views.
Unlike the oracle setting, estimated representations may contain errors in scene geometry and viewpoint placement (see examples in Fig. 3 for Viewpoint Imagination and Fig. 4 for Cross-view Integration). We first evaluate estimated endpoint RGB, then examine whether additional estimated representations can recover its remaining errors. More implementation details are provided in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh:
迄今为止,我们的分析侧重于从地面真实3D场景中得出的神谕。 我们现在调查,如果必须从所观察到的观点来估计所想象的状态,它们是否继续得到互补的好处。
与甲骨文设定不同,估计的表示可能包含场景几何和视角位置的错误(参见图3中的 Viewpoint Imagination和图4中的交叉视图整合). 我们首先评估估计的终点点RGB,然后审查其他估计的表述是否能够弥补其剩余的错误。 附录A.3提供了更详细的执行情况。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 3 , estimated endpoint RGB reduces accuracy from 57.2% to 54.7% on Viewpoint Imagination, potentially due to errors in scene reconstruction and instruction-conditioned viewpoint estimation. Nevertheless, all six alternative representations provide complementary evidence, yielding potential error-recovery scores of 61.7-65.6%.
Their effectiveness varies across question types: panorama performs best on Open-space Direction (70.3%), while depth performs best on Nearest Object (61.5%). Selecting the best representation per question type further increases the score to 67.2%. In contrast, estimated RGB improves Cross-view Integration from 68.0% to 76.0%. This difference may reflect the greater difficulty of reconstructing a 3D scene and estimating an instructed movement endpoint from a single observation in Viewpoint Imagination. Estimated depth further increases the score to 82.0% (Table 4 ). Together, these results suggest that representation complementarity persists even under imperfect imagination.
blocks.zh:
如表3所示,估计的终点RGB将 Viewpoint 想象中的精度从57.2%降低到54.7%,这可能是由于场景重建错误和具有指导条件的视角估计. 尽管如此,所有六个备选表述都提供了补充证据,得出61.7%-65.6%的潜在误差回收分数。
其有效性因问题类型而异:全景在开放空间方向上表现最好(70.3%),在最近物体上表现最好(61.5%)。 每个问题类型选择最佳表现方式,将得分进一步提高到67.2%。 相比之下,估计RGB改进了交叉视图整合,从68.0%提高到76.0%. 这种差异可能反映了重构3D场景和从 Viewpoint Imagination 的单一观察中估计指示移动端点的更大困难. 估计深度进一步将分数提高到82.0%(表4)。 这些结果表明,即使在不完美的想象下,代表性的互补性仍然存在。

blocks.en: Finding 3: Even when estimated RGB alone does not help, alternative representations derived from the same estimated scene still improve spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 调查结果3:即使仅靠估计的RGB没有帮助,来自同一估计场景的替代表述仍然改善了空间推理.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Overview of GEARS , combining prediction-agreement gating with adaptive representation selection.
blocks.zh: 图5:GEARS概览,结合预测-协议定位和适应性代表选择。

blocks.en: 5 Our Method: Gated Evidence and Adaptive Representation Selection ( GEARS )
blocks.zh: 5 我们的方法:证据和适应性代表性选择(GEARS)

blocks.en: Our findings in Sec. 4 reveal two challenges for practical spatial imagination: estimated RGB does not always improve reasoning, and different representations provide complementary spatial information. These observations motivate adaptive decisions about when to use imagined evidence and which representation to provide.
blocks.zh: 我们在Sec.4中的调查结果揭示了实际空间想象的两个挑战:估计RGB并不总是能改善推理,不同的表述提供了互补的空间信息. 这些意见促使人们作出适应性决定,决定何时使用想象中的证据以及提供何种代表。

blocks.en: We therefore introduce GEARS , as shown in Fig. 5 , a lightweight test-time strategy that decides when to use imagined evidence and which representation to provide. A gating stage keeps the answer when predictions with and without the estimated endpoint RGB agree, while a routing stage selects the evidence that best suits the spatial information required by the question. For Viewpoint Imagination, we consider all six alternative representations, while for Cross-view Integration, we consider estimated depth as the additional representation.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提出GEARS,如图5所示,这是一种轻量级测试时间战略,它决定何时使用想象的证据,以及提供何种代表。 当预测有和没有估计终点RGB时,一个配位阶段会保留答案,而一个配位阶段则选择最适合问题所要求的空间信息的证据. 关于Videopoint Imagination,我们考虑所有六种备选表述,而关于交叉观点整合,我们认为估计深度是附加表述。

blocks.en:
We compare GEARS against two existing spatial imagination methods, MindJourney Yang et al. (2025b) and AVIC Yu et al. (2026) . For a consistent comparison, all methods use GPT-6.1-sol as the final reasoner and are evaluated on the same benchmark questions.
Implementation details, an ablation of the two stages, and baseline configurations are provided in Appendix A.4 .
As shown in Table 5 , GEARS also achieves the highest accuracy on most question types (61.4% accuracy on Viewpoint Imagination and 77.7% on Cross-view Integration).
These results demonstrate that the complementary benefits identified in our controlled analysis can be translated into practical improvements through adaptive representation selection.
blocks.zh:
我们比较GEARS与现有的两种空间想象方法,MindJourney Yang等人(2025b)和AVIC Yu等人(2026). 为了进行一致的比较,所有方法都使用GPT-6.1-sol作为最终的原因,并在相同的基准问题上进行评估.
附录A.4提供了实施细节、两个阶段的缩减和基线配置。
如表5所示,GEARS在大多数问题类型上也达到了最高的精度(Videopoint Imagination的精度为61.4%,交叉视图整合的精度为77.7%).
这些结果表明,我们所控制的分析中确定的互补效益可以通过适应性代表性选择转化为实际改进。

blocks.zh: 表5:与ImagiRep上的测试时间空间想象方法的比较. 每个问题类型报告精确度(%),最佳结果用粗体表示.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce ImagiRep , a controlled benchmark for studying how representations of imagined spatial states affect reasoning. Our findings reveal that accurate imagined RGB does not guarantee effective reasoning, while alternative representations offer complementary benefits even under imperfect imagination. Building on these insights, GEARS improves test-time spatial reasoning. More broadly, our study calls for a shift in world model development from merely generating accurate views to providing spatial representations that enable effective reasoning about the unseen world.
blocks.zh: 我们提出ImagiRep, 用于研究想象空间状态的表达如何影响推理的控制基准。 我们的调查结果表明,准确的想象中的保护责任并不能保证有效的推理,而替代表述即使在不完善的想象下也能提供互补的好处。 基于这些见解,GEARS改进了测试时间空间推理. 更广泛地说,我们的研究要求把世界模型的发展从仅仅产生准确的观点转变为提供空间表现,以便能够对看不见的世界进行有效的推理。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: Our study has several limitations. First, ImagiRep focuses on static indoor scenes and selected spatial reasoning tasks, leaving dynamic environments and more complex interactions unexplored. Second, our estimated representation analysis relies on a limited set of world models, and not all representations are evaluated across both settings. Finally, despite the improvements achieved by GEARS , a substantial gap remains compared with oracle-assisted results, suggesting that reliable estimation and selection of imagined spatial evidence remain open challenges. Future work could extend our framework to more diverse environments, world models, and reasoning tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有几个局限性。 首先,ImagiRep专注于静态室内场景和部分空间推理任务,使得动态环境和更复杂的相互作用得不到探索. 第二,我们的估计代表性分析依靠有限的一套世界模型,并非所有的代表性都经过两种环境的评价。 最后,尽管GEARS取得了改进,但与甲骨文协助的成果相比,仍存在很大差距,这表明对想象中的空间证据的可靠估计和选择仍然是公开的挑战。 今后的工作可以把我们的框架扩大到更加多样化的环境、世界模式和推理任务。

blocks.en: For Viewpoint Imagination, we run HY-World 2.0 ( Team HY-World, 2026 ) on each initial image and export the generated world as a Gaussian-splat scene with a fused mesh. The camera trajectory is planned in this world from the initial image and the movement instruction only, without any ground-truth poses, views, or answers. Gemini 3.7 Flash decomposes the movement instruction into simple actions, describes the referenced objects, and localizes them with bounding boxes in the initial image. Ray casting from the initial camera through these image regions estimates the objects’ distances and 3D positions in the generated scene. Using the scene’s obstacles, we plan the shortest traversable path to each target and convert it into camera translations and rotations. The camera stops at a navigable position at a preposition-dependent distance from the target (e.g., 0.8 m for “walk to”). Scene scale is calibrated with metric depth estimated by MoGe-2 ( Wang et al., 2025 ) from the initial image. Endpoint RGB, depth, surface normals, panorama, and top-down geometry are rendered from the same generated world at the planned endpoint with the same camera settings as the oracle views. Video captures the planned camera trajectory, while spatial text describes the planned camera movements. Over all Viewpoint Imagination questions, the planned endpoints deviate from the ground truth by a median of 1.4 m in position and 14 ∘ 14^{\circ} in heading, which partly explains why estimated endpoint RGB falls short of oracle RGB in Sec. 4.4 . Figure 7 shows more examples.
blocks.zh: 对于 Viewpoint Imagination,我们在每个初始图像上运行HY-World 2.0(Team HY-World,2026年),并将生成的世界导出为带有引信网格的高斯板场景. 摄像头的轨迹是从最初的图像和运动指令中规划出来的,没有任何地面真实的姿势、观点或答案。 双子座 3.7 Flash将运动指令分解成简单的动作,描述被引用的对象,并在初始图像中用边框将其定位. Ray通过这些图像区域从最初的相机中投影,估计物体的距离和生成场景中的3D位置. 利用现场的障碍,我们计划最短的可穿越路径到每个目标,并将其转换成相机翻译和旋转. 相机停在与目标相距的可导航位置(例如“行走到”0.8米)。 场景尺度由MoGe-2(Wang等人,2025年)从最初的图像中估算出测量深度来校准. 端点RGB,深度,表面常态,全景,以及自上而下几何,都是在计划中的端点由同一个生成的世界提供,其相机设置与甲骨文视图相同. 视频能捕捉计划中的相机轨迹,而空间文本则描述了计划中的相机运动. 在所有的 Viewpoint 想象问题中,计划中的终点偏离地面真理的中位数为1.4米的位置和14 ∘ 14^{\circ}标题,这部分解释了为什么估计的终点RGB在Sec. 4.4中低于oracle RGB. 图7显示了更多实例。

blocks.en: For Cross-view Integration, we estimate camera poses from the observed images using VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . With two reference images, we select a target pose midway between their estimated poses. With three reference images, the model plans a camera trajectory. The reference images and estimated poses provide the context for Stable Virtual Camera (SEVA) ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , which synthesizes RGB at the target viewpoint without constructing an explicit 3D scene. We use MoGe-2 (ViT-L) ( Wang et al., 2025 ) to estimate depth from the synthesized endpoint RGB. Depth is the only additional estimated representation considered in this setting.

blocks.en: In the gating stage, the reasoner answers each question twice, from the observed view(s) alone and with the estimated endpoint RGB added. If the two answers agree, this answer is returned. Otherwise, the question enters the routing stage, where the reasoner sees the question, the observed view(s), and the estimated endpoint RGB, together with a short description of each option, and chooses which evidence to use without answering the question. The prompt includes brief guidance on which evidence suits each question type (prompts in Appendix A.5 ). The reasoner then answers using the chosen evidence. All calls use GPT-6.1-sol with high reasoning effort.
